name: Shiina Kokomi
source:
Favorite subject: English
Hobbies: Collecting aromatherapy candles
Favorite food: Melonpan
Hated food: Tuna

A second-year student belonging to the rhythmic gymnastics club. In addition to that she is the Ace of said club and everyone in Seiou High is holding high expectations for her, which she fulfills more or less. For that, she is admired by many of her fellow students and has many friends, but despite her great popularity, Kokomi manages to stay quite humble and kind.
